findings.finding: Demant's 9 Oct MAR pre-release puts the hearing aid market at +6-7% in value in Q3 and 4-5% for 2026, against the ~3% global demand Amplifon's FY26 outlook still assumes; with H1 organic at 3.5% and Q3 consensus at 4.3%, Amplifon's '>3%' organic guide looks conservative and could be firmed or raised in the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide confirmed with a beat: +4.6% after Q1 2026 (6 May) and +8.2% after H1 2026 (31 Jul). A slight cut to the FY25 guide in Oct 2025 gave -3.5%. The market has rewarded firming here this year.
findings.original_quote: Amplifon outlook (20260730 release, English original): 'global market demand growth in the region of 3% compared to 2025; ... a significant improvement in organic growth, above 3% compared to 2025'. Demant: 'we estimate that the hearing aid market grew by around 6-7% in value in Q3 (5% YTD) ... with 4-5% being the most likely outcome (previously 3-4%)'
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: AMP closed +6.8% on 9 Oct, the day of Demant's release, and is +7.4% over 20 sessions, so the market read-through is in the price. What is not priced is whether Amplifon itself moves its own guide. The company consensus holds margin exactly at guide (23.6%), which is what it would look like if nobody had yet modelled a raise. Size is small because Demant's market value growth is partly wholesale launch ASP (Oticon Reveal) that retail does not capture.
findings.independence: Amplifon's own 'solid start to the third quarter' (20260730 release, https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-07/20260730_187528.pdf) and Morgan Stanley's 4.6% Q3 estimate (https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/amplifon-rally-pre-dati-2720315) point the same way

findings.finding: The Q3 comparison is about two points tougher than Q2's. Q3 2025 was the quarter Amplifon 'returned to organic growth' after a negative Q2 2025, so the 4.3% consensus implies a two-year-stack acceleration. Demant's retail arm (Hearing Care), the closest listed peer, slowed from 8% organic in Q2 to 6% in Q3 on what Demant called 'slightly tougher' comparatives.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: An organic miss on Q3 2025 (weak quarter, slight cut to the FY guide) gave -3.5% on 30 Oct 2025; organic beats in Q1 and Q2 2026 gave +4.6% and +8.2%
findings.why_not_priced: The previews (MS 4.6% vs consensus 4.3%) and the 9 Oct rally read Demant's +6-7% headline and say nothing about the base effect. If the comparison were priced, estimates would sit below the Q2 print of 4.7%, which they barely do. This is an inference from two documents, a proxy plus the company's own wording on Q3 2025, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Demant Hearing Care Q3 +6% organic vs Q2 +8% (https://via.ritzau.dk/ir-files/13560112/15199920/30935/2026-12%20Upgraded%20financial%20outlook%20for%202026%20and%20resumption%20of%20share%20buy-backs.pdf); Demant Q2 Hearing Care 8% (https://hearingtracker.com/news/demant-reports-strong-q2-hearing-aid-growth-raises-2026-outlook)

findings.finding: Management said on 30 July that the third quarter had a 'solid start' and that 'positive momentum continues into Q3', which bounds the risk of a large organic miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two releases after this kind of language in 2026 were bought (+4.6%, +8.2%)

findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, public for three months and reflected in a bar that sits near Q2's growth rate. It is kept only as a floor under the quarter, sized near zero.

findings.finding: The ordinary and extraordinary shareholders' meeting votes on the same day (29 Oct) on the ~56m-share reserved capital increase to GN, the equity part of the GN Hearing consideration (about 17% of capital post-deal). The Holland family controls more than 70% of voting rights, so approval is a formality; the release and call will also update the GN Hearing closing timetable, which is still expected by year-end.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The deal announcement (16 Mar 2026) and the EUR 453m ABB (21-22 May) weighed on the stock; since then GN-related news has been read positively (Equita/Citi/JPM upgrades)

findings.why_not_priced: The share issue terms have been public since March and the vote outcome is predetermined. The only unpriced piece is the closing timing and any antitrust news, and no regulatory decision was found, so the direction is unknown and the finding is sized at zero.
